title: Each included step draws from its own seeded stream (#463)
proves: two included steps, the entry and a nested step draw different values and fake names for one rngSeed
a second run with the same seed gives the same rows
the order of two independent steps does not change their rows; the step key is the step path, not its position (an entry <execute> library keeps one run-wide stream and follows the call order)
./model/10_first.xml and model/10_first.xml are the same step
the rows do not depend on the project directory: each equivalent runs the project and the variant in two directories
rngSeed on an included step has no effect: the entry seed governs the run
numProcess on a seeded step generate keeps the rows: a seeded generate runs single-process
the check fails when a step repeats the draws of another stream

patch.old:
<!-- 10 first: one draw and one fake name for each entry row -->
    <include uri="model/10_first.xml"/>
    <!-- 20 second: the same for each entry row; its nested step 30 draws again -->
    <include uri="model/20_second.xml"/>
patch.new:
<!-- 20 second: the same for each entry row; its nested step 30 draws again -->
    <include uri="model/20_second.xml"/>
    <!-- 10 first: one draw and one fake name for each entry row -->
    <include uri="model/10_first.xml"/>
